subject: A507E7D3A781E22F35AB894700017D84
introduction: These hundred prayers begin “Praise be to Thee” or “Glory be unto Thee”, and what they give thanks for is specific: guidance found, a deed made possible, a thirst quenched, a fear removed. Most go on to ask for the strength to turn gratitude into service. The Psalter is the great book of such prayer; Deuteronomy’s “beware that thou forget not” is its warning; the one leper in ten who returned is its parable. Job’s “blessed be the name of the Lord”, said when everything had been taken, is the hardest form of praise.
questions: What are these prayers grateful for? Make a list from the first ten.
Why do so many of them pass from thanks to a request to serve?
Job blessed God in loss. Is that the same gratitude, or something else?

outside.why: Turn to the Kingdom of Bounty. Make a joyful noise unto the Lord; serve the Lord with gladness.
Aid us to remember Thee and praise Thee. Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits.
Remembrance, praise and service asked for together. Paul joins them too: pray without ceasing; in every thing give thanks.
Praise for having been enabled to perform a deed. Ten were cleansed, and one turned back to give thanks: where are the nine?
Sinner though I be, I have no refuge save Thyself. God be merciful to me a sinner.
Praise to God who created me, then nourished me. When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the Lord thy God; beware that thou forget not.
The Qur’an attaches a promise to gratitude: if ye give thanks, I will give you more.
Stretch forth thy hands in supplication. O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
I was thirsty, and Thou gavest me to drink. He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
Hopkins’s praise for particular things: glory be to God for dappled things.
The Lord gave, and the Lord hath taken away; blessed be the name of the Lord. These prayers give thanks for gifts. Do they, anywhere, give thanks without one?

shortfall: Ninety further prayers of praise repeat these in other words; companions were set to the first stretch only.
